data.name: Fleet Craft
data.detailed_description:
In "Fleet Craft", you can experience grand and pure warfare.

Custom unit

All the units that players can control can be customized. It consists of a vehicle and accessories. The attachments include various weapons, radars, shields, etc.

Different units not only have different attributes but also unique passive skills. Even the same weapon can produce different effects when installed on different vehicles.

Beyond-visual-range combat, vision and radar

The range of most weapons is longer than the field of vision of the unit itself. You need the units in the front row to provide visibility for the rear firepower in order to attack effectively.

Some attachments can increase the field of view of the unit, and the radar can display the position of the enemy within a large area outside the field of view.

However, the enemies shown by the radar cannot be directly attacked. This can only provide strategic references for you or the AI.

Legion operations

You don't need to focus on controlling every single unit. Just configure the appropriate units for your fleet and then directly control it to carry out mobile attacks.

You can split or merge your fleet at any time because essentially each unit is separate.

Formation system

The formation system can significantly reduce the operational requirements for players. It enables you to directly command the fleet instead of constantly operating each unit.

Encounter battle

Battle with an AI that randomly customizes units.

Campaign

Passing each level of the campaign can make you stronger. Unlock new units and attachments. And earn technology points.

Points can be used to provide personalized upgrades for units or attachments.

data.short_description: "Fleet Craft" is a real-time strategy game with a science fiction theme. Players can build land fleets composed of large tanks, robots and other units. You can customize the weapons on the unit to achieve different functions.
